statements.impact_statement: CVE-2025-12863 was assigned for libxml2 issue #1012, a use-after-free reported when a namespaced node is moved from one document to another with xmlAddChild() or xmlReplaceNode() and the source document is then freed (https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2/-/issues/1012). The libxml2 maintainer answered that this is documented, expected behaviour of the tree API and not a security issue: after moving nodes between documents the caller must call xmlReconciliateNs() or move the node with xmlDOMWrapAdoptNode(), otherwise its namespace pointers can refer to declarations freed with the old document (https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/libxml2/-/issues/1012#note_2608283). The use-after-free is therefore in a caller that skips that step, not in libxml2, and the CVE record has been rejected: "This CVE was assigned for a libxml2 issue#1012 but later deemed not valid" (https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2025-12863). The current DHI libxml2 package for Debian 13 (amd64 and arm64) exports xmlReconciliateNs and xmlDOMWrapAdoptNode, the two calls the maintainer names.
